propositions: _code_review_prompt_id excludes activated project code-review criteria and admits only static built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through default plan-review namespace and lacks code-review membership resolution
_code_review_prompt_id must accept optional repo_root parameter and expand admission to include active project criteria resolved via code_review.registry.effective_criteria
calibrate_criterion must conditionally route to code-review arm when repo_root is provided and criterion_id is in active project criteria
EvalError raised during code-review spec loading must be re-raised with located information including the logical criterion_id
backward compatibility requires plan-review criteria and built-in code-review criteria to function unchanged when repo_root is absent or not applicable
